questions.prompt: Which property changes the text color of an element?
questions.explanation: The color property sets the foreground (text) color.

questions.prompt: Which selector targets the element with id="main"?
questions.explanation: # selects by id, . by class, and a bare name by element type.

questions.prompt: Which lists the CSS box model layers from the inside out?
questions.explanation: Content is surrounded by padding, then border, then margin.

questions.prompt: Which property controls the space between an element's content and its border?
questions.explanation: Padding is inside the border; margin is outside.

questions.prompt: How do you select all elements that have the class "card"?
questions.explanation: A leading dot selects by class name.

questions.prompt: Which declaration makes text italic?
questions.explanation: font-style controls italic or oblique rendering.

questions.prompt: What does position: relative do on its own?
options: Offsets the element from its normal position while keeping its space in the flow
questions.explanation: Relative positioning shifts the box visually but the original space remains reserved.

questions.prompt:
Which rule wins for a

: #x { color: red } or .a.b.c { color: blue }?
options: #x, because one ID selector outranks any number of class selectors
.a.b.c, because three classes beat one id
Neither; they conflict and are ignored
questions.explanation: Specificity compares IDs first, then classes, then types, so the ID wins regardless of source order.

questions.prompt: In a flex container with flex-direction: row, which property aligns items along the main axis?
questions.explanation: justify-content works on the main axis (horizontal for row); align-items works on the cross axis.

questions.prompt: Two adjacent block siblings have margin-bottom: 20px and margin-top: 30px. What gap results by default?
options: 30px, because adjacent vertical margins collapse to the larger one
questions.explanation: Vertical margin collapsing between sibling blocks uses the larger margin.

questions.prompt: What does box-sizing: border-box change?
options: Margin is included in the width
The declared width and height include padding and border
questions.explanation: With border-box, content shrinks to make room for padding and border within the declared size.

questions.prompt: On the font-size property, what is 1.5em relative to?
options: The parent element's computed font size
questions.explanation: For font-size, em refers to the inherited font size; for other properties it refers to the element's own.

questions.prompt: Which element does z-index reliably affect (without flex or grid parents)?
options: A static block with float: none
questions.explanation: z-index applies to positioned elements, and to flex and grid items.

questions.prompt: Which elements does li:nth-child(2n+1) select?
options: The odd-numbered children: 1st, 3rd, 5th and so on
questions.explanation: 2n+1 yields 1, 3, 5 and so on.

questions.prompt: Which declaration creates a new stacking context?
questions.explanation: An opacity below 1 (as well as transform, filter and some others) creates a stacking context.

questions.prompt: With grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)), how does auto-fit differ from auto-fill?
options: auto-fit collapses empty tracks so the existing items stretch to fill the row
questions.explanation: auto-fill keeps empty tracks; auto-fit collapses them so 1fr tracks grow.

questions.prompt: A normal (non-important) declaration in an unlayered style rule conflicts with one inside a @layer. Which wins?
options: The unlayered declaration, regardless of specificity
The layered one if its specificity is higher
questions.explanation: Unlayered normal styles take precedence over layered ones; layer order and specificity matter only among comparable origins.

questions.prompt: How does :where() differ from :is() in specificity?
options: The specificity of :where() is always zero, while :is() takes its most specific argument
The specificity of :is() is always zero
Both add the specificity of their first argument only
questions.explanation: Use :where() for easily overridable defaults.

questions.prompt: A long unbroken string overflows its flex item. Which change typically fixes it?
questions.explanation: Flex items default to min-width: auto, so they won't shrink below their content size; min-width: 0 allows shrinking.

questions.prompt: Which statement about CSS custom properties is true?
options: They cannot be overridden on child elements
They are resolved only at parse time
They are global and cannot be scoped
They inherit by default and are resolved per element at computed-value time
questions.explanation: Custom properties follow the cascade and inheritance, so scoped overrides work.

questions.prompt: What do container queries (@container) respond to?
options: The size of the nearest ancestor container that has a container-type set
questions.explanation: Container queries let components adapt to their container instead of the viewport.
